_doc: OSHA parser data (oel_us_osha.py). z2_cas / z3_cas: Tables Z-2 and Z-3 print no CAS, so the substance name (start of the cell) maps to a CAS here. z2_skip: Z-2 rows that apply only where a substance-specific standard is stayed or excepted (Z-1 footnotes d, 5, 8). specific: PELs of the substance-specific standards; every value is checked against its section text by the 'evidence' phrase (the build fails if the phrase is missing from the downloaded eCFR section).
